questions.stem:
设正项数列 \(\{a_{n}\}\) 单调递减且趋于零, 则下列结论正确的是
①当 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n\) 收敛时，\(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^{n-1} \sqrt{a_n a_{n+1}}\) 必绝对收敛.
②当 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n\) 发散时, \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^{n-1} \sqrt{a_n a_{n+1}}\) 必条件收敛.
③当 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n\) 收敛时，\(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^{n-1} \sqrt{a_n a_{n+1}}\) 必条件收敛.
④当 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n\) 发散时, \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^{n-1} \sqrt{a_n a_{n+1}}\) 必发散.

solution.analysis_md:
由已知, \(\lim_{n\to \infty}a_n = 0,\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}(-1)^{n - 1}\sqrt{a_n a_{n + 1}}\) 为交错级数.
由正项数列 \(\{a_{n}\}\) 单调递减，知 \(\sqrt{a_{n + 1}a_{n + 2}}\leqslant \sqrt{a_n a_{n + 1}}\) ，故 \(\{\sqrt{a_n a_{n + 1}}\}\) 单调递减，又
\[
0 \leqslant \sqrt {a _ {n} a _ {n + 1}} \leqslant \frac {a _ {n} + a _ {n + 1}}{2}
\]
且 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{a_n + a_{n + 1}}{2} = 0\) ，由夹逼准则，知 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\sqrt{a_n a_{n + 1}} = 0\) ，由莱布尼茨定理，知 \(\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}(-1)^{n - 1}\sqrt{a_n a_{n + 1}}\) 收敛，④错误.
当 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n\) 收敛时，由 \(\sqrt{a_n a_{n+1}} \leqslant a_n\) 及比较审敛法，知 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \sqrt{a_n a_{n+1}}\) 收敛，故 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^{n-1} \sqrt{a_n a_{n+1}}\) 绝对收敛，①正确，③错误.
当 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n\) 发散时，由 \(\sqrt{a_n a_{n+1}} \geqslant a_{n+1}\)，知 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \sqrt{a_n a_{n+1}}\) 发散，从而 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^{n-1} \sqrt{a_n a_{n+1}}\) 条件收敛，②正确。综上所述，A 正确。

questions.stem:
下列结论正确的是
①若 \(f(x)\) 在 \(x = a\) 处连续，且 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(a + x^3) - f(a)}{x^2}\) 存在，则 \(f'(a)\) 存在.
②若 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}n\left[f\left(a + \frac{1}{n}\right) - f(a)\right](n\) 为正整数)存在，则 \(f^{\prime}(a)\) 存在.
③若 \( f(x)=(x-a)\varphi(x) \) ，其中 \( \varphi(x) \) 在x=a处连续，则 \( f'(a) \) 存在.
④若存在 \(\delta > 0\), 对 \(\forall x \in (a - \delta, a + \delta)\), 有 \(|f(x)| \leqslant L|x - a|^{\alpha}\), 其中 \(L > 0, \alpha > 1\) 为常数, 则 \(f'(a)\) 存在.

solution.analysis_md:
由①不能推出 \( f'(a) \) 存在, 因为 \( \lim_{x\to0}\frac{f(a+x^3)-f(a)}{x^2}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{f(a+x^3)-f(a)}{x^3}\cdot x \)
存在, 有可能  \( \lim_{x\to0}\frac{f(a+x^{3})-f(a)}{x^{3}} \)  为  \( \infty \)  (因  \( \infty\cdot0^{n} \)  型极限可能存在).
由 ② 不能推出 \( f'(a) \) 存在.
如 \(f(x) = \begin{cases} x\sin \frac{\pi}{x}, & x \neq 0, \\ 0, & x = 0, \end{cases}\) 则 \(\lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \frac{f(0 + \Delta x) - f(0)}{\Delta x} = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \sin \frac{\pi}{\Delta x}\) 不存在，即 \(f'(0)\) 不
存在,但 \( \lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)-f(0)}{\frac{1}{n}}=\lim_{n\to\infty}\sin n\pi=0. \)
由 ③ 可推出 \(f(x)\) 在 \(x = a\) 处可导.
\[
f ^ {\prime} (a) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow a} \frac {f (x) - f (a)}{x - a} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow a} \frac {(x - a) \varphi (x) - 0}{x - a} = \varphi (a)
\]
由 ④ 可推出 \( f'(a) \) 存在.
由 \(|f(x)| \leqslant L |x - a|^{\alpha}\), 知 \(f(a) = 0\), 且
\[
0 \leqslant \left| \frac {f (x) - f (a)}{x - a} \right| \leqslant L | x - a | ^ {a - 1}, \quad x \in (a - \delta , a + \delta)
\]
由 \(\alpha > 1\), 知 \(\lim_{x \to a} L |x - a|^{\alpha - 1} = 0\). 故由夹逼准则知 \(\lim_{x \to a} \left| \frac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a} \right| = 0\), 从而
\[
f ^ {\prime} (a) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow a} \frac {f (x) - f (a)}{x - a} = 0
\]
综上所述，C 正确.

questions.stem: 下列积分发散的是

solution.analysis_md:
对于选项 D, 有 \(\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} e^{|x|} \sin x \, \mathrm{d}x = \int_{-\infty}^{0} e^{-x} \sin x \, \mathrm{d}x + \int_{0}^{+\infty} e^{x} \sin x \, \mathrm{d}x\). 由
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {b} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \sin x \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} (\sin x - \cos x) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {b} = \frac {1}{2} [ \mathrm{e} ^ {b} (\sin b - \cos b) + 1 ]
\]
可知 \(\lim_{b\to +\infty}\int_0^b\mathrm{e}^x\sin x\mathrm{d}x\) 不存在，故 \(\int_0^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^x\sin x\mathrm{d}x\) 发散，从而 \(\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{|x|}\sin x\mathrm{d}x\) 发散.D正确.对于选项A，由 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}x^{\frac{7}{2}}\cdot \frac{1}{x^3\sqrt{1 + x}} = 1\) ，并根据比较审敛法，知 \(\int_1^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^3\sqrt{1 + x}}\) 收敛.
对于选项 B,  \( \int_{0}^{+\infty} x^{2} e^{-x} dx = \Gamma(3) = 2 \) . 故原积分收敛.
对于选项 C,  \( \int_{2}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x\ln^{2}x}=\int_{2}^{+\infty}(\ln x)^{-2}\mathrm{d}(\ln x)=-\frac{1}{\ln x}\bigg|_{2}^{+\infty}=\frac{1}{\ln2} \) ，故原积分收敛.

questions.stem: 设 \(A\) 是 \(m \times n\) 矩阵, 则非齐次线性方程组 \(AX = b\) 有解的充分必要条件是

solution.analysis_md:
\(\mathbf{A}_{m\times n}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{b}\) 有解 \(\Leftrightarrow \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}) = \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{b})\Leftrightarrow \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}) = \mathrm{r}\left[(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{b})^{\mathrm{T}}\right] = \mathrm{r}\left[ \begin{array}{c}\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\\ \mathbf{b}^{\mathrm{T}} \end{array} \right]\)
\(\Leftrightarrow \mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 与 \(\left[ \begin{array}{l}\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\\ \mathbf{b}^{\mathrm{T}} \end{array} \right]\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 基础解个数相等
因 \(\left[ \begin{array}{c}\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\\ \mathbf{b}^{\mathrm{T}} \end{array} \right]\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 的解必满足 \(\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) ，故 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{b}\) 有解 \(\Leftrightarrow \mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 与 \(\left[ \begin{array}{c}\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\\ \mathbf{b}^{\mathrm{T}} \end{array} \right]\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 同解.
D 正确.
对于选项 A,  \( r(A) = m \)  (A 行满秩), 则  \( r(A) = r(A, b) = m \) . 故 AX = b 有解; 但 AX = b 有解, 未必有  \( r(A) = m \) ,
对于选项 B, AX = b 有解  \( \Leftrightarrow r(A) = r(A, b) \) ，但  \( r(A) \)  未必为 n.
对于选项 C, 由前面推导知, AX = b 有解  \( \Leftrightarrow \mathrm{r}(A^{\mathrm{T}}) = \mathrm{r}\begin{bmatrix} A^{\mathrm{T}} \\ b^{\mathrm{T}} \end{bmatrix} \) , 但秩未必为 m.

questions.stem: 设 \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & a \end{bmatrix}\) 与 \(B = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}\) 合同, 则

solution.analysis_md:
实对称矩阵 A 与 B 合同的充分必要条件是它们有相同的正、负惯性指数.
由 \(|\lambda E - B| = \left| \begin{array}{ccc}\lambda -1 & 0 & 0\\ 0 & \lambda -1 & -1\\ 0 & -1 & \lambda \end{array} \right| = (\lambda -1)(\lambda^2 -\lambda -1) = 0\)
得 B 的特征值为  \( \lambda_{1}=1>0,\lambda_{2}=\frac{1-\sqrt{5}}{2}<0,\lambda_{3}=\frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}>0. \)
由 \(|\mu E - A| = \left| \begin{array}{ccc}\mu -2 & -1 & 0\\ -1 & \mu -2 & 0\\ 0 & 0 & \mu -a \end{array} \right| = (\mu -a)(\mu -3)(\mu -1) = 0\)
得 A 的特征值为  \( \mu_{1}=a,\mu_{2}=3,\mu_{3}=1 \) .
故 \(a < 0\). B 正确.

questions.stem: 设 4 阶实矩阵 \(A = (a_{ij}) = (a_1, a_2, a_3, a_4), a_{11}\) 的代数余子式 \(A_{11} \neq 0\), 且 \(|A| = 0\), 则下列选项正确的是

solution.analysis_md:
由 \(|\mathbf{A}| = 0\) ，知 \(\mathbf{A}^{*}\mathbf{A} = |\mathbf{A}|E = \mathbf{O}\) ，故
\[
\mathrm{r} (\mathbf {A} ^ {*}) + \mathrm{r} (\mathbf {A}) \leqslant 4
\]
又由 \(A_{11} \neq 0\)，知 \(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*}) \geqslant 1\)，所以 \(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}) \leqslant 3\). 当 \(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}) < 3\) 时，\(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*}) = 0\)，与 \(A_{11} \neq 0\) 矛盾. 故 \(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}) = 3, \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*}) = 1\).
由 \(A_{11} = \left| \begin{array}{lll}a_{22} & a_{23} & a_{24}\\ a_{32} & a_{33} & a_{34}\\ a_{42} & a_{43} & a_{44} \end{array} \right|\) 知，知 \(\left| \begin{array}{ll}a_{22}\\ a_{32}\\ a_{42} \end{array} \right|\) ， \(\left| \begin{array}{ll}a_{23}\\ a_{33}\\ a_{43} \end{array} \right|\) ， \(\left| \begin{array}{ll}a_{24}\\ a_{34}\\ a_{44} \end{array} \right|\) 线性无关，故 \(\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\alpha_{4}\) 线性无关，排
除选项 A.
而  \( \alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3} \)  不一定线性无关, 排除选项 B 和 D.
由 \(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*}) = 1\) ，知 \(\mathbf{A}^{*}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) ，有 \(4 - \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*}) = 3\) 个线性无关解.
又由 \(A^{*}A = O\) ，知 \(\mathbf{A}\) 的列向量 \(\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\alpha_{4}\) 均是 \(A^{*}X = 0\) 的解，故C正确.

questions.stem: 设 \(A, B\) 是随机事件, 若 \(AB = \overline{AB}\), 且 \([P(A)]^2 + [P(B)]^2 = \frac{1}{2}\), 则 \(P(A)P(B) =\)

solution.analysis_md:
由 \(AB = \overline{A}\overline{B}\), 知 \((AB)(\overline{A}\overline{B}) = AB = \overline{A}\overline{B}\).
又由 \((AB)(\overline{A}\overline{B}) = \emptyset\) ，知 \(AB = \emptyset, \overline{A}\overline{B} = \emptyset, A \cup B = \Omega.\)
故 \(P(A) + P(B) = 1\) ，从而
\[
[ P (A) + P (B) ] ^ {2} = [ P (A) ] ^ {2} + [ P (B) ] ^ {2} + 2 P (A) P (B) = \frac {1}{2} + 2 P (A) P (B) = 1
\]
所以 \(P(A)P(B) = \frac{1}{4}\) ，C正确.

questions.stem: 设随机变量 \((X, Y)\) 的概率密度为 \(f(x, y) = \begin{cases} ax, & 0 < y < x < 1, \\ 0, & \text{其他}. \end{cases}\) 若 \(P\left\{X < \frac{1}{2}, Y < b\right\} = \frac{1}{8}\), 则 \(a, b\) 的取值范围是

solution.analysis_md:
由概率密度的性质,有 \(\int_{-\infty}^{\frac{1}{2}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y = 1\) ，即
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {a} a x \mathrm{d} y = \frac {a}{3} = 1
\]
设 \(a = 3\)
又 \(P\left\{X < \frac{1}{2}, Y < b\right\} = \iint_{x < \frac{1}{2}, y < b} f(x, y) \, \mathrm{d}x \, \mathrm{d}y\)
图 \(b \leqslant 0\) 时，
\[
P \left\{X <   \frac {1}{2}, Y <   b \right\} = 0
\]
当 \(0 < b < \frac{1}{2}\) 时，
\[
P \left\{X <   \frac {1}{2}, Y <   b \right\} = \int_ {0} ^ {6} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} 3 x \mathrm{d} y + \int_ {6} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {6} 3 x \mathrm{d} y = \frac {3 b}{8} - \frac {b ^ {3}}{2}
\]
当 \(b \geqslant \frac{1}{2}\) 时，
\[
P \left\{X <   \frac {1}{2}, Y <   b \right\} = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{2}} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {\theta} ^ {x} 3 x \mathrm{d} y = \frac {1}{8}
\]
综上所述, \( a=3,b\geqslant\frac{1}{2} \) .D正确.

questions.stem: 设随机变量 \(X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}\) 相互独立, 且都在 \([-1, 1]\) 上服从均匀分布, \(\Phi(x)\) 为 \(N(0,1)\) 的分布函数, 则 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} P\left\{\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n} X_{i}}{\sqrt{n}} \leqslant 1\right\} =\)

solution.analysis_md:
由于 \(X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}\) 相互独立，且均在 \([-1, 1]\) 上服从均匀分布，故 \(EX_{n} = 0\)
\(DX_{n} = \frac{2^{2}}{12} = \frac{1}{3}\). 根据独立同分布的中心极限定理, 对 \(\forall x \in \mathbb{R}\), 有
\[
\lim _ {x \to \infty} P \left\{\frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i} - E \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i}\right)}{\sqrt {D \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i}\right)}} \right\} \leqslant x \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} = \lim _ {\tau \to \infty} P \left\{\frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i}}{\sqrt {n}} \leqslant x \right\} = \lim _ {n \to \infty} P \left\{\frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i}}{\sqrt {n}} \leqslant \frac {x}{\sqrt {3}} \right\} = \Phi (x) \\ \sqrt {D \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i}\right)} \end{array} \right.
\]
取 \(\frac{x}{\sqrt{3}} = 1\) ，即 \(x = \sqrt{3}\) .C正确.
填空题

questions.stem: 设 \( f(t) = \lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{\sum_{i = 1}^{n}\frac{t - 1}{[n + (t - 1)i]\sqrt{\frac{t - 1}{n}}}}{(t > 1)} \) ( \( t > 1 \) ), 则 \( \lim_{t\to +\infty}f(t) = \) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
\(f(t) = \lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}\frac{t - 1}{[n + (t - 1)i]\sqrt{\frac{t}{n} - 1}} = \lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k = 1}^{n}\frac{t - 1}{n(1 + \frac{t - 1}{n})\sqrt{x + \frac{t - 2}{n} - 1}}\)
\[
= \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {\frac {t - 1}{n}}{\left(1 + \frac {t}{n}\right) \sqrt {1 + \frac {t}{n} - \frac {t}{n}}} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \int_ {1} ^ {n} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \sqrt {x - 1}}
\]
故 \(\lim_{t\to +\infty}f(t) = \lim_{t\to +\infty}\int_{1}^{t}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x}} = \int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x}} = \int_{1}^{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x - 1}} +\int_{2}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x - 1}} +\int_{2}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x - 1}}\)
\[
= \lim _ {\xi \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \int_ {1 + \xi} ^ {2} \frac {2 \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x - 1})}{1 + (\sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2}} + \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} \int_ {2} ^ {b} \frac {2 \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x - 1})}{1 + (\sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2}}
\]
\[
= \lim _ {\xi \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} 2 \arctan \sqrt {x - 1} \Big | _ {1 + \xi} ^ {2} + \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} 2 \arctan \sqrt {x - 1} \Big | _ {2} ^ {b}
\]
\[
= \lim _ {\xi \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left(\frac {\pi}{2} - 2 \arctan \sqrt {\xi}\right) + \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} 2 \arctan \sqrt {b - 1} - \frac {\pi}{2}
\]
\[
= \frac {\pi}{2} - 0 + \pi - \frac {\pi}{2} = \pi
\]

questions.stem: 设函数 \( y = y(x) \) 由 \( \left\{ \begin{array}{l} x = t^2 + 2t, \\ \frac{1}{2} \sin y - y + t^2 = 1 \end{array} \right. \) (\( t > 0 \)) 确定, 则 \( \left. \frac{d^2 y}{dx^2} \right|_{x=3} = \) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
已知方程组同时对 \(t\) 求导, 得
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{d} t} = 2 t + 2 \\ \frac {1}{2} \cos y \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} - \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + 2 t = 0 \end{array} \right.
\]
解得 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t} = 2(t + 1),\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{2t}{1 - \frac{1}{2}\cos y}\) 故
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {t}{(t + 1) \left(1 - \frac {1}{2} \cos y\right)}
\]
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} x ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} t} \left(\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}\right) \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\left(1 - \frac {1}{2} \cos y\right) ^ {2} - t ^ {2} (t + 1) \sin y}{2 (t + 1) ^ {3} \left(1 - \frac {1}{2} \cos y\right) ^ {3}}
\]
当 \(x = 3\) 时，\(t = 1, y = 0\)，故 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}^2 y}{\mathrm{d} x^2}\bigg|_{x = 3} = \frac{1}{8}\).

所求面积部分曲面记为 \(\Sigma, \Sigma\) 关于 \(yOz\) 平面对称, 第一卦限部分曲面方程为
\[
x = \sqrt {2 y - y ^ {2}}, \quad (y, z) \in D _ {y z}
\]
其中 \(D_{yz}\) 为 \(\Sigma\) 在 \(yOz\) 面上的投影区域.
\[
x _ {y} ^ {\prime} = \frac {1 - y}{\sqrt {2 y - y ^ {2}}}, \quad x _ {z} ^ {\prime} = 0
\]
\[
\sqrt {1 + x _ {y} ^ {\prime 2} + . x _ {z} ^ {\prime 2}} = \sqrt {\frac {2 y - y ^ {2} + (1 - y) ^ {2}}{2 y - y ^ {2}}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 y - y ^ {2}}}
\]
由 \( \left\{\begin{aligned}z&=\frac{1}{2}(x^{2}+y^{2})\\ x^{2}+y^{2}&=2y\end{aligned}\right. \)  消去x，得z=y.
故 \(D_{yz}:0\leqslant z\leqslant y,0\leqslant y\leqslant 2\) ，如图所示所求面积为
\[
S = 2 \iint_ {D _ {y z}} \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 - (y - 1) ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {2} \mathrm{d} y \int_ {0} ^ {y} \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 - (y - 1) ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} z
\]
\[
= 2 \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {y}{\sqrt {1 - (y - 1) ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} y = 2 \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {y - 1}{\sqrt {1 - (y - 1) ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} y + \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\sqrt {1 - (y - 1) ^ {2}}} \right]
\]
\[
= 2 \left[ - \sqrt {1 - (y - 1) ^ {2}} \right| _ {0} ^ {2} + \arcsin (y - 1) \Big | _ {0} ^ {2} \Big ] = 2 \pi
\]

questions.stem: 设 \(\alpha\) 为 3 维非零实列向量, \(E\) 为 3 阶单位矩阵, \(A = E - \frac{3}{\alpha^T \alpha} \alpha \alpha^T\), 则 \(tr(A) =\) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
\(\operatorname{tr}(\mathbf{A}) = \operatorname{tr}(\mathbf{E}) - \operatorname{tr}\left(\frac{3}{\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha}\alpha \alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\right) = 3 - \frac{3}{\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha}\operatorname{tr}(\alpha \alpha^{\mathrm{T}}) = 3 - \frac{3}{\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha}\cdot \alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha\)
\[
= 3 - 3 = 0
\]

questions.stem: 设 \(X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n} (n > 1)\) 为来自总体 \(X \sim N(\mu, \sigma^{2})\) 的简单随机样本, 其中 \(\mu\) 已知, \(\sigma > 0\), 若 \(\hat{\sigma} = k \sum_{i=1}^{n} |X_{i} - \mu|\) 是 \(\sigma\) 的无偏估计量, 则 \(k =\) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
由已知, \(X_{i} \sim N(\mu, \sigma^{2})\), 故 \(X_{i} - \mu \sim N(0, \sigma^{2})\), 则
\[
\begin{array}{l} E \left| X _ {i} - \mu \right| = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} | x | \cdot \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} e ^ {- \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {x}{\sigma}\right) ^ {2}} d x = \frac {2}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x e ^ {- \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {x}{\sigma}\right) ^ {2}} d x \\ = \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \left[ - \sigma \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {x}{\sigma}\right) ^ {2}} \right] \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} = \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \sigma \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(E\hat{\sigma} = k\sum_{i = 1}^{n}E|X_i - \mu | = k\cdot n\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}\sigma = \sigma\) ，解得 \(k = \frac{1}{n}\sqrt{\frac{\pi}{2}}\)
三、解答题

questions.stem: 设可导函数 \( y = f(x) \) 由方程 \( \mathrm{e}^{x - 2y} - x^2 y = 1 \) 确定, 计算 \( \lim_{x\to 1^{+}}\frac{\sin(x - 1)}{\sqrt{(x - 1)^3}}\int_0^1 f(t\sqrt{x - 1})dt. \)

solution.analysis_md:
由 \(\mathrm{e}^{x - 2y} - x^2 y = 1\)，当 \(x = 0\) 时，\(y = 0\)，即 \(f(0) = 0\).
等式两边对 \(x\) 求导，有
\[
\mathrm{e} ^ {x - 2 y} (1 - 2 y ^ {\prime}) - 2 x y - x ^ {2} y ^ {\prime} = 0.
\]
将 \(x = 0, y = 0\) 代入上式，得 \(f'(0) = y'(0) = \frac{1}{2}\).
又 \(\int_0^1 f(t\sqrt{x - 1})\mathrm{d}t = \frac{t\sqrt{x - 1} = u}{\sqrt{x - 1}}\frac{1}{\sqrt{0}}\int_0^{\sqrt{x - 1}}f(u)\mathrm{d}u\) ，故
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin (x - 1)}{\sqrt {(x - 1) ^ {3}}} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (t \sqrt {x - 1}) d t = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin (x - 1)}{(x - 1) ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {x - 1}} f (u) d u \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin (x - 1)}{x - 1} \cdot \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {x - 1}} f (u) d u = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {x - 1}} f (u) d u}{x - 1} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {f (\sqrt {x - 1})}{2 \sqrt {x - 1}} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {f (\sqrt {x - 1}) - f (0)}{\sqrt {x - 1} - 0} = \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime} (0) = \frac {1}{4} \\ \end{array}
\]

questions.stem:
设 \(z = f(u,v)\) 有二阶连续偏导数, \(u = x - 2\sqrt{y}, v = x + 2\sqrt{y}\), 且满足
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} - y \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} - \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = 1 2 a (a \neq 0)
\]
(I) 求  \( \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} \) ;
(II) 若 \(\frac{\partial f(u,0)}{\partial u} = -3u^2, f(0,v) = -v^3\), 求 \(f(u,v)\) 的极值.

solution.analysis_md:
(I) 由复合函数求导法, 有
\[
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} \frac {\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} \frac {\partial v}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} \\ \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} \frac {\partial u}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} \frac {\partial v}{\partial y} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} \left(- y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right) + \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} = y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial v} - \frac {\partial z}{\partial u}\right) \\ \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u ^ {2}} + 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial v ^ {2}} \\ \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} = \left(- y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right) \left[ \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u ^ {2}} \left(- y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right) + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \right] + \frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} + \\ y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \left[ \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} \left(- y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right) + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial v ^ {2}} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \right] - \frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} \\ = y ^ {- 1} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u ^ {2}} - 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial v ^ {2}}\right) + \frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial u} - \frac {\partial z}{\partial v}\right) \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x^2} - y\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial y^2} - \frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u^2} + 2\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u\partial v} + \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial v^2} - \left(\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u^2} - 2\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u\partial v} + \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial v^2}\right) -\)
\[
\frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial u} - \frac {\partial z}{\partial v}\right) - \frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial v} - \frac {\partial z}{\partial u}\right)
\]
\[
= 4 \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} = 1 2 a
\]
所以 \(\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u\partial v} = 3a\)
(Ⅱ) 由(Ⅰ)知
\[
\frac {\partial f}{\partial u} = \int 3 a \mathrm{d} v + \varphi_ {1} (u) = 3 a v + \varphi_ {1} (u)
\]
由 \(\frac{\partial f(u,0)}{\partial u} = -3u^2\) ，知 \(\varphi_{1}(u) = -3u^{2}\)
故 \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial u} = 3av - 3u^2, f(u, v) = \int (3av - 3u^2) \mathrm{d}u + \varphi_2(v) = 3auv - u^3 + \varphi_2(v)\).
由 \(f(0,v) = -v^3\) ，得 \(\varphi_{2}(v) = -v^{3}\) ，则 \(f(u,v) = 3auv - u^3 -v^3.\)
由 \( \left\{\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}&=3av-3u^{2}=0,\\ \frac{\partial f}{\partial v}&=3au-3v^{2}=0,\end{aligned}\right. \)  得驻点 \( P_{1}(0,0),P_{2}(a,a). \)
又 \(\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial u^2} = -6u, \frac{\partial^2f}{\partial u\partial v} = 3a, \frac{\partial^2f}{\partial v^2} = -6v.\)
对于 \(P_{1}(0,0), A = 0, B = 3a, C = 0.\)
由 \(AC - B^{2} = -9a^{2} < 0\) ，知 \(f(u,v)\) 在点 \(P_{1}(0,0)\) 处无法取得极值.
对于 \(P_{2}(a,a),A = -6a,B = 3a,C = -6a.\)
由于 \(AC - B^{2} = (-6a)(-6a) - 9a^{2} = 27a^{2} > 0\)
当 \(a > 0\) 时，\(A = -6a < 0, f(a, a) = a^3\) 为极大值.
当 \(a < 0\) 时，\(A = -6a > 0, f(a, a) = a^3\) 为极小值.

questions.stem: 设 \(D = \{(x,y)\mid x^2 +y^2\leqslant 1,x\geqslant 0,y\geqslant 0\}\) ，计算 \(I = \iint_{D}\max \left\{y + 1,\frac{2}{1 + x}\right\} \mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.\)

solution.analysis_md:
当 \( y + 1 = \frac{2}{1 + x} \) 时, 双曲线 \( y + 1 = \frac{2}{1 + x} \) 将 \( D \) 分成 \( D_{1} \) 与 \( D_{2} \), 如图所示.
\[
\max \left\{y + 1, \frac {2}{1 + x} \right\} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {2}{1 + x}, & (x, y) \in D _ {1} \\ 1 + y, & (x, y) \in D _ {2} \end{array} \right.
\]
故 \(I = \iint_{D_1}\frac{2}{1 + x}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y + \iint_{D_2}(1 + y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y = I_1 + I_2.\)
\[
I _ {1} = \iint_ {D _ {1}} \frac {2}{1 + x} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1 - x}{1 + x}} \frac {2}{1 + x} \mathrm{d} y
\]
\[
= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(\frac {2}{1 + x} \cdot \frac {1 - x}{1 + x}\right) \mathrm{d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1 - x}{(1 + x) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x
\]
\[
= 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left[ \frac {- 1}{1 + x} + \frac {2}{(1 + x) ^ {2}} \right] d x = - 2 \ln (1 + x) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} + 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm{d} (1 + x)}{(1 + x) ^ {2}}
\]
\[
= - 2 (\ln 2 - 0) - 4 \frac {1}{1 + x} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = - 2 \ln 2 - 4 \left(\frac {1}{2} - 1\right)
\]
\[
= 2 - 2 \ln 2
\]
![](/uploads/books/daf65b13d24c0382017a67e314814a8f8d5ab6cd50c8c7937aa785d3a1c3791a.jpg)
\[
\begin{array}{l} I _ {2} = \iint_ {D _ {2}} (1 + y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} y \int_ {\frac {1 - y}{1 + y}} ^ {\sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}}} (1 + y) \mathrm{d} x \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 + y) \left(\sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} - \frac {1 - y}{1 + y}\right) d y \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} d y + \int_ {0} ^ {1} y \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} d y - \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 - y) d y \\ = \frac {\pi}{4} - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} d (1 - y ^ {2}) - \left(y - \frac {1}{2} y ^ {2}\right) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} \\ = \frac {\pi}{4} - \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {2}{3} (1 - y ^ {2}) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - \frac {1}{2} = \frac {\pi}{4} - \frac {1}{6} \right. \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(I = I_{1} + I_{2} = 2 - 2\ln 2 + \frac{\pi}{4} -\frac{1}{6} = \frac{\pi}{4} -2\ln 2 + \frac{11}{6}.\)

(I) 由 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)}{x} = 0\) ，知 \(\lim_{x\to 0}f(x) = f(0) = 0\) ，且
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x)}{x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x) - f (0)}{x} = f ^ {\prime} (0) = 0
\]
设 \(y = f(x)\) 在点 \((x, f(x))\) 处的切线方程为
\[
Y - f (x) = f ^ {\prime} (x) (X - x)
\]
令 \(Y = 0\) ，则 \(u(x) = X = x - \frac{f(x)}{f'(x)} (x\neq 0)\) ，且
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} u (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left[ x - \frac {f (x)}{f ^ {\prime} (x)} \right] = - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\frac {f (x) - f (0)}{x}}{\frac {f ^ {\prime} (x) - f ^ {\prime} (0)}{x}} = - \frac {f ^ {\prime} (0)}{f ^ {\prime \prime} (0)} = 0
\]
\(f(x)\) 在 \(x = 0\) 处的二阶泰勒展开式为
\[
f (x) = f (0) + f ^ {\prime} (0) x + \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (0)}{2 !} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right) = \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime \prime} (0) x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)
\]
故 \(\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{u(x)}{x} = \lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{x - \frac{f(x)}{f'(x)}}{x} = \lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\left[1 - \frac{f(x)}{xf'(x)}\right]\)
\[
= 1 - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime \prime} (0) x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x f ^ {\prime} (x)}
\]
\[
= 1 - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime \prime} (0) + \frac {o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {2}}}{f ^ {\prime} (x) - f ^ {\prime} (0)} = 1 - \frac {1}{2} \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (0)}{f ^ {\prime \prime} (0)}
\]
\[
= 1 - \frac {1}{2} = \frac {1}{2}
\]
于是 \(a_{n} = \lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\left[\frac{u(x)}{x}\right]^{n} = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n}.\)
(Ⅱ) 由(Ⅰ)知, \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n^{2} a_{n} = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n^{2} \left( \frac{1}{2} \right)^{n}\).
令 \(S(x) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n^2 x^{n-1}\), 则可求得其收敛半径 \(R = 1\).
当 \(x = \pm 1\) 时，级数发散，故收敛域为 \((-1,1)\)
\[
S (x) = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} n ^ {2} x ^ {n - 1} = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} n \cdot n x ^ {n - 1} = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} (n x ^ {n}) ^ {\prime} = \left(\sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} n x ^ {n}\right) ^ {\prime} = \left(x \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} n x ^ {n - 1}\right) ^ {\prime}
\]
记 \(S_{1}(x) = \sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}nx^{n - 1}\) ，则
\[
S _ {1} (x) = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} (x ^ {n}) ^ {\prime} = \left(\sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} x ^ {n}\right) ^ {\prime} = \left(\frac {x}{1 - x}\right) ^ {\prime} = \frac {1}{(1 - x) ^ {2}}
\]
故 \(S(x) = \left[x \cdot \frac{1}{(1 - x)^2}\right]' = \frac{1 + x}{(1 - x)^3}, x \in (-1, 1)\).
令 \(x = \frac{1}{2}\) ，则
\[
\sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} n ^ {2} \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {n} = \frac {1}{2} S \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) = \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {1 + \frac {1}{2}}{\left(1 - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {3}} = 6
\]
【注】题目没有 \(f''(x)\) 连续的条件，(I)中在求 \(\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{f(x)}{f'(x)}\) 与 \(\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{f(x)}{xf'(x)}\) 时，不能用洛必达法则.

(I) 由 \(A \sim B\), 知
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {3} a _ {i i} = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {3} b _ {i i} \\ | \mathbf {A} | = | \mathbf {B} | \end{array} \right.
\]
即 \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 5 = a + 5 \\ 3 = 4a + c \end{array} \right.\), 解得 \(a = 0, c = 3\).
由 \(|\lambda E - A| = (\lambda - 1)^2 (\lambda - 3)\), 知 \(A\) 的特征值为 \(\lambda_1 = \lambda_2 = 1, \lambda_3 = 3\).
由 A 是实对称矩阵, 知 A 必相似于对角矩阵, 故  \( B = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & b & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ -1 & -2 & 4 \end{bmatrix} \)  也可对角化, 且与 A
有相同的特征值, 为  \( \mu_{1} = \mu_{2} = 1, \mu_{3} = 3 \) , 故
\[
\mathrm{r} (\boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {B}) = \mathrm{r} \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & - b & - 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & - 3 \end{array} \right] = 1
\]
所以 b = -2.
综上所述， \(a = 0,b = -2,c = 3.\)
(Ⅱ) 由 \((\mathbf{E} - \mathbf{A})\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\), 得特征向量 \(\alpha_{1} = (-1, 1, 0)^{\mathrm{T}}, \alpha_{2} = (0, 0, 1)^{\mathrm{T}}\).
由 \( (3E-A)X=0 \) ，得特征向量 \( \alpha_{3}=(1,1,0)^{\mathrm{T}} \) .
令  \( P_{1}=(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}) \) ，则  \( P_{1}^{-1}AP_{1}=\mathrm{diag}(1,1,3) \) .
由 \((\pmb {E} - \pmb {B})\pmb {X} = \pmb{0}\) ，得特征向量 \(\pmb{\beta}_{1} = (-2,1,0)^{\mathrm{T}},\pmb{\beta}_{2} = (3,0,1)^{\mathrm{T}}.\)
由(3E-B)X=0,得特征向量 \( \beta_{3}=(1,0,1)^{\mathrm{T}} \) .
令  \( P_{2}=(\boldsymbol{\beta}_{1},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{2},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{3}) \) ，则  \( P_{2}^{-1}BP_{2}=diag(1,1,3) \) 。故
\[
\boldsymbol {P} _ {1} ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {P} _ {1} = \boldsymbol {P} _ {2} ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {B} \boldsymbol {P} _ {2}
\]
即 \((\pmb{P}_1\pmb{P}_2^{-1})^{-1}\pmb{A}(\pmb{P}_1\pmb{P}_2^{-1}) = \pmb{B}\) ，所以
\[
\boldsymbol {P} = \boldsymbol {P} _ {1} \boldsymbol {P} _ {2} ^ {- 1} = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - 2 & 3 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \end{array} \right] ^ {- 1}
\]
\[
= \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 1 & 0 \\ \frac {1}{2} & 1 & - \frac {1}{2} \\ - \frac {1}{2} & - 1 & \frac {3}{2} \end{array} \right]
\]
\[
= \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - \frac {1}{2} & - 2 & \frac {3}{2} \\ - \frac {1}{2} & 0 & \frac {3}{2} \\ \frac {1}{2} & 1 & - \frac {1}{2} \end{array} \right]
\]
则  \( P^{-1}AP = B. \)
(Ⅲ) 将(Ⅱ)中  \( \alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3} \)  (已正交) 单位化, 得
\[
\gamma_ {1} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (- 1, 1, 0) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \gamma_ {2} = (0, 0, 1) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \gamma_ {3} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (1, 1, 0) ^ {\mathrm{T}}
\]
令  \( Q=(\gamma_{1},\gamma_{2},\gamma_{3}) \) ，则 Q 为正交矩阵，且  \( Q^{T}AQ=diag(1,1,3) \) ，
\[
\boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {X} \xlongequal {\boldsymbol {X} = \boldsymbol {Q} \boldsymbol {Y}} \boldsymbol {Y} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {Y} = y _ {1} ^ {2} + y _ {2} ^ {2} + 3 y _ {3} ^ {2}
\]
令 \(\begin{bmatrix} y_1 \\ y_2 \\ y_3 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} z_1 \\ z_2 \\ z_3 \end{bmatrix}\), 记为 \(Y = P_3 Z\), 则 \(X^T A X \xlongequal{X = Q P_3 Z} z_1^2 + z_2^2 + z_3^2\).
令 \(C_1 = QP_3\) ，则 \(C_1^{\mathrm{T}}AC_1 = E\) ，故 \(\mathbf{A} = (C_1^{\mathrm{T}})^{-1}C_1^{-1} = (C_1^{-1})^{\mathrm{T}}C_1^{-1}\)
令 \(C = C_{1}^{-1} = (QP_{3})^{-1} = P_{3}^{-1}Q^{-1} = P_{3}^{-1}Q^{\mathrm{T}}\) ，即
\[
\boldsymbol {C} = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \sqrt {3} \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \cdot & 1 \\ \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & 0 \end{array} \right] = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ \sqrt {\frac {3}{2}} & \sqrt {\frac {3}{2}} & 0 \end{array} \right]
\]
使得  \( A = C^{T} C \) .
【注】（Ⅲ）也可用配方法化  \( X^{T}AX \)  为规范形，从而求出可逆矩阵 C，使得  \( A=C^{T}C \) .

(I) 解方程 \( f'(x) + \frac{1}{\lambda} f(x) = 0 \), 得 \( f(x) = C e^{-\frac{x}{\lambda}} \).
由 \(\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x)\mathrm{d}x = \int_0^{+\infty}C\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{x}{\lambda}}\mathrm{d}x = 1\) ，得 \(C = \frac{1}{\lambda}\) 故 \(X\) 的概率密度为
\[
f (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{\lambda} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\lambda}}, & x > 0 \\ 0, & x \leqslant 0 \end{array} \right.
\]
\(Z\) 的分布函数 \(F_{Z}(z)\) 为
\[
\begin{array}{l} F _ {Z} (z) = P \{X Y \leqslant z \} = P \{X Y \leqslant z, Y = - 1 \} + P \{X Y \leqslant z, Y = 1 \} \\ = P \{X \geqslant - z, Y = - 1 \} + P \{X \leqslant z, Y = 1 \} \\ = P \{X \geqslant - z \} P \{Y = - 1 \} + P \{X \leqslant z \} P \{Y = 1 \} \\ = \frac {1}{3} [ 1 - F _ {X} (- z) ] + \frac {2}{3} F _ {X} (z) \\ \end{array}
\]
其中 \(F_{X}(x)\) 是 \(X\) 的分布函数，故
\[
f _ {Z} (z) = F _ {Z} ^ {\prime} (z) = \frac {1}{3} f (- z) + \frac {2}{3} f (z)
\]
当 \(z < 0\) ，即 \(-z > 0\) 时，\(f(-z) = \frac{1}{\lambda} \mathrm{e}^{\frac{z}{\lambda}}, f(z) = 0.\)
当 \(z = 0\) 时，\(f(z) = f(-z) = 0\).
当 \(z > 0\) ，即 \(-z < 0\) 时， \(f(z) = \frac{1}{\lambda}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{z}{\lambda}},f(-z) = 0.\)
故 \(f_{z}(z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}\frac{1}{3\lambda}\mathrm{e}^{\frac{z}{\lambda}}, & z <   0\\ 0, & z = 0\\ \frac{2}{3\lambda}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{z}{\lambda}}, & z > 0 \end{array} \right.\)
(Ⅱ) 由(Ⅰ)知, X 服从参数为  \( \frac{1}{\lambda} \)  的指数分布.
故 \(DX = \lambda^2\) ，又 \(EY = (-1)\times \frac{1}{3} +1\times \frac{2}{3} = \frac{1}{3},\)
\[
\begin{array}{l} \operatorname{Cov} (X, Z) = E (X Z) - E X \cdot E Z = E \left(X ^ {2} Y\right) - E X \cdot E (X Y) \\ = E X ^ {2} E Y - (E X) ^ {2} E Y \\ = [ E X ^ {2} - (E X) ^ {2} ] E Y = D X \cdot E Y = \frac {1}{3} \lambda^ {2} \neq 0 \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(X\) 与 \(Z\) 相关.
